concept: IAM: EC2 role via instance profile instead of access keys
tests: Giving EC2 access to Secrets Manager without long-lived credentials on the instance.
expected: Attach an IAM instance profile with permission to read the secret: temporary, auto-rotated credentials via the metadata service. Triggers: "without storing long-lived credentials", EC2 → AWS API.
why_not: Keys in an AMI or user data get exposed and never rotate; root credentials for a workload, never.
